architectureDecision.reason: Repository inspection after the Stage 5 merge confirms a single index.astro route, starter Astro component/layout structure, Astro as the only application dependency, an empty Astro config, and no backend, API, persistence, authentication, shared state, client framework integration, migration, or server-runtime concern. The approved specification also explicitly excludes those behaviors, so the Lite implementation can keep structural constraints in the specification and Stage 7 plan without a separate architecture artifact.
